title: Juicy Date-Night Tunisian Passion Fruit Tagine
description: A rich and exotic dish from Tunisia, featuring the sweetness of passion fruit, perfectly balanced with the earthiness of agave and the spiciness of chili peppers. This recipe is perfect for a romantic dinner.
instructions: Rinse the passion fruit pulp and set it aside.
Prepare the agave leaves by rinsing them and pat-drying them with paper towels.
Heat ghee in the agave leaf-lined tagine over medium heat.
Add the sliced onion and cook until it's translucent.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the sliced chili peppers and cook for 2 minutes.
Add the cumin, paprika, salt, and black pepper, and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the passion fruit pulp and stir to combine.
Cover the tagine and cook for 10 minutes, or until the passion fruit is tender.
Garnish with chopped parsley and serve hot.
